component.name: BlueGlance
component.summary: Battery levels of your Bluetooth devices at a glance

description.p: Never get surprised by a dead mouse, keyboard or pair of headphones again. BlueGlance shows the battery level of everything connected to your computer in a desktop widget inspired by the macOS Batteries widget, in your top bar or system tray, and in a clean GTK 4 app.

ul.li: Desktop widget in three sizes, pinned below your windows, with light and dark styles
AirPods and Beats: left, right and charging case levels
Mice, keyboards, headsets, game controllers, Logitech receivers and more
Notifications before a battery runs out, and optionally when it is full
Top bar menu on GNOME and tray icon on KDE Plasma, Cinnamon, XFCE and others
Starts with your session in the background; one switch to turn that off

description.p: On GNOME, the desktop widget and top bar menu are provided by the BlueGlance GNOME Shell extension, which the app can enable for you.
First release: desktop widget, AirPods support, notifications, tray and GNOME Shell integration.
